review_method: Inventory first: the complete pinned2Kings book was inventoried as723 actual units in25 chapters, including1:18a–d, before any new-book source review. Read all103 complete actual units across the separately frozen1–3 and8 packets, every proposed retained target and necessary surrounding context. Separately reread all79 and29 complete source/target/category/rationale triples in bounded displays. A combined middle display clipped79 tokens of1–3pair52; its complete triple was explicitly redisplayed and reread. A coherent author stage preserved the original draft, polished possessive punctuation and preserved the explicit fallen-upon-Elisha phrase in2:13; all stage-one complete triples were reread. A second preserved stage corrected seven complete triples across the two packets: two remaining possessives in1–3 and one in8, the action-only wall-and-slinger ending, causal restraint for the red-water appearance, and unambiguous reporting of Hazael’s succession without reassigning source face pronouns. All seven corrected full triples were separately reread before freeze. Connections retain particular persons, royal notices, repeated words, prophecies with stated outcomes, narrative recaps, meaningful labelled local literary parallels and explicit contrasts. The initial curated pass is not exhaustive discovery, original-language or apparatus work, independent human specialist approval, or a numerical/geographical/legal harmonization.
pin_method: Fresh raw fetches of every retained source/target book at the fixed commit, exact Git blob rehash against saved immutable registries, raw SHA256 and complete parsed-cache equality.
